module.purpose: Provides edge-based camera scrolling for the editor when the pointer approaches viewport boundaries.
module.summary: This manager tracks whether edge scrolling is active, applies a configurable delay and easing period, computes pointer proximity to each viewport edge, and translates the camera accordingly. It accounts for coarse pointers, viewport insets, zoom level, viewport size, and editor-configured scroll speed while avoiding movement when the camera is locked.
module.businessContext: Supports intuitive canvas navigation on desktop and touch-oriented screens. If it fails, users cannot reliably pan the editor by approaching viewport edges.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the camera is locked, updating edge scrolling leaves the camera unchanged.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Locked cameras must not respond to edge-scroll updates.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the pointer is near an edge, camera movement begins only after the configured delay.
moduleContractTests.then: editor.setCamera is not called before the edge-scroll delay expires
moduleContractTests.rationale: The delay prevents immediate camera movement when entering the edge region.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the pointer leaves all edge regions, edge scrolling stops and its duration resets.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Leaving the edge must clear the active scrolling state.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the pointer is beyond an edge, the proximity factor is capped at magnitude one.
moduleContractTests.then: the returned factor is Math.min(1, (min - pMin) / dist)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Scroll intensity must remain bounded regardless of pointer distance.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the pointer is coarse, the edge proximity region includes the configured pointer width.
moduleContractTests.then: proximity is computed using pMin and pMax expanded by the coarse pointer width
moduleContractTests.rationale: Touch pointers need an expanded effective region near screen edges.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When edge scrolling moves the camera, its depth coordinate remains unchanged.
moduleContractTests.when: editor.setCamera(new Vec(x + scrollDeltaX, y + scrollDeltaY, z))
moduleContractTests.then: the resulting camera has the original z value
moduleContractTests.rationale: Edge scrolling translates the camera position without changing zoom/depth.

units.name: updateEdgeScrolling

detail.name: updateEdgeScrolling
preconditions: The manager has an editor reference exposing camera options and edge-scroll configuration.
elapsed is a numeric tick duration.
postconditions: If the camera is locked, no edge-scrolling state or camera position is changed.
When neither edge-scroll proximity factor is nonzero, active edge scrolling is stopped and its duration is reset to zero.
When edge scrolling is active, its accumulated duration is increased by elapsed.
Camera movement is considered only after the accumulated edge-scroll duration exceeds editor.options.edgeScrollDelay.
invariants: _edgeScrollDuration is reset to zero whenever edge scrolling transitions to inactive.
_edgeScrollDuration is reset to zero when edge scrolling transitions from inactive to active.
Edge-scroll easing is used only when editor.options.edgeScrollEaseDuration is greater than zero.
edgeCases: When editor.getCameraOptions().isLocked is true, the method returns immediately without evaluating edge proximity.
When both edge-scroll proximity factors are zero while edge scrolling is active, _isEdgeScrolling becomes false and _edgeScrollDuration becomes zero.
When either edge-scroll proximity factor is nonzero while edge scrolling is inactive, _isEdgeScrolling becomes true and duration accumulation starts from zero.
When accumulated duration is equal to or below editor.options.edgeScrollDelay, delayed camera movement is not performed.
When edgeScrollEaseDuration is non-positive, the eased progress uses the non-eased path.
stateMutations: editor camera position indirectly through edge-scroll camera movement
detail.summary: Updates edge-scrolling state and camera movement for a tick when the pointer is near a screen edge. Camera updates are skipped while camera movement is locked, and edge scrolling begins only after the configured delay.

specTests.when: updateEdgeScrolling is called with an elapsed duration.
specTests.then: The method returns without changing edge-scroll state or camera position.
Edge scrolling is active and camera movement is performed using the edge-scroll factor and configured easing behavior.

units.name: getEdgeProximityFactors

detail.name: getEdgeProximityFactors
detail.signature: private getEdgeProximityFactors(position: number, dimension: number, isCoarse: boolean, insetStart: boolean, insetEnd: boolean)
preconditions: position and dimension are numeric values representing the pointer position and axis size.
isCoarse, insetStart, and insetEnd are boolean flags.
postconditions: Returns a numeric proximity factor derived from the supplied position, dimension, pointer precision, and edge-inset flags.
Does not mutate manager state or its arguments.
invariants: The calculation is limited to the supplied axis and does not depend on mutable external state.
edgeCases: Positions near an applicable start or end edge produce the corresponding edge-proximity factor.
Positions not near an applicable edge produce the non-edge factor.
Changing isCoarse can change the proximity calculation used for the same position and dimension.
The insetStart and insetEnd flags independently affect treatment of the two axis ends.
detail.summary: Computes a numeric edge-proximity factor for a position along one axis. The factor accounts for the axis dimension, pointer precision, and whether the relevant start and end edge insets apply.

units.name: getEdgeScroll

detail.name: getEdgeScroll
detail.signature: getEdgeScroll(position: number, dimension: number, isCoarse: boolean, insetStart: boolean, insetEnd: boolean): number
preconditions: position and dimension are numeric axis coordinates and extents.
editor.options.coarsePointerWidth is available when isCoarse is true.
postconditions: Returns a number representing edge-scroll proximity.
Returns a positive value when the pointer region is before the effective start threshold.
Returns a negative value when the pointer region is beyond the effective end threshold.
The returned edge factor is capped at magnitude 1.
invariants: The coarse-pointer adjustment expands the tested region on both sides by coarsePointerWidth when isCoarse is true.
The start threshold is 0 when insetStart is true; otherwise it is edgeScrollDistance.
The end threshold is dimension when insetEnd is true; otherwise it is dimension minus edgeScrollDistance.
A position within the effective thresholds produces no edge-scroll factor.
edgeCases: When isCoarse is false, the pointer-width adjustment is zero.
When insetStart is true, the start edge is evaluated from coordinate 0 rather than from the configured distance.
When insetEnd is true, the end edge is evaluated at dimension rather than at dimension minus the configured distance.
When the adjusted position exceeds the configured scroll range, the corresponding factor is clamped to magnitude 1.
detail.summary: Computes a normalized edge-scroll factor from an axis position relative to the configured scroll thresholds. The result indicates proximity to the start or end edge and is capped at magnitude one.

specLiterals.role: Upper bound used to clamp the edge-scroll factor.
Default pointer-width adjustment and effective inset start boundary.

specTests.when: getEdgeScroll is called with isCoarse=false and the corresponding inset flags.

specTests.then: The method returns the positive ratio (effectiveStart - adjustedMinimum) / edgeScrollDistance, capped at 1.

units.name: moveCameraWhenCloseToEdge

detail.name: moveCameraWhenCloseToEdge
preconditions: The manager has access to an editor instance with current pointer coordinates, viewport bounds, and camera state.
postconditions: When edge scrolling is indicated, the editor camera is moved in the direction and amount determined by the current edge proximity.
When no edge scrolling is indicated, the editor camera remains unchanged.
invariants: Camera movement is driven by the current screen-space pointer position relative to the viewport edges.
edgeCases: Pointer position away from all viewport edges produces no camera movement.
Pointer position near a viewport edge produces movement toward that edge.
Pointer position near a corner may produce movement on both camera axes.
stateMutations: Editor camera state may be updated.
detail.summary: Moves the editor camera when the current pointer position is sufficiently close to a screen edge. It leaves the camera unchanged when edge proximity does not require scrolling.
